meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan — **dark spots + dull skin** ke liye India mein main **10% Vitamin C** se start karne ko prefer karunga, especially agar pehli baar use kar rahe ho. Stable forms jaise **Ethyl Ascorbic Acid** practical choice hain, kyunki pure L-ascorbic acid ke muqable mein zyada stable hote hain. [phdbeauty.com](https://phdbeauty.com/blogs/general-advice/best-vitamin-c-serum-india-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/products/vitamin-c-ethyl-ascorbic-acid-10-acetyl-glucosamine-1?_pos=5&_sid=3c1dd7096&_ss=r&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥇 Best overall: Minimalist Vitamin C 10%**  
10% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid + 1% Acetyl Glucosamine; fragrance-free aur non-comedogenic hai. Dark spots, uneven tone aur dullness ke liye achha beginner-friendly option. [phdbeauty.com](https://phdbeauty.com/blogs/general-advice/best-vitamin-c-serum-india-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/products/vitamin-c-ethyl-ascorbic-acid-10-acetyl-glucosamine-1?_pos=5&_sid=3c1dd7096&_ss=r&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 Agar pigmentation zyada hai: Deconstruct 10% Vitamin C + 0.5% Ferulic Acid**  
Liposomal Vitamin C aur ferulic acid ka combination hai; brand specifically dark spots, pigmentation aur dullness ke liye formulate karta hai. [thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/collections/serums/products/vitamin-c-and-ferulic-acid-serum?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥉 Glow + dark spots: Dot & Key 10% Vitamin C + 5% Niacinamide**  
Vitamin C ke saath niacinamide bhi milta hai, jo pigmentation/uneven tone mein useful ho sakta hai. [www.dotandkey.com](https://www.dotandkey.com/blogs/skin-care/dermatologist-recommended-face-serums-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Plum 15%** — agar tum pehle se Vitamin C use karte ho aur skin easily irritate nahi hoti. Beginner ke liye main 10% se shuru karunga.

### Kaise use karna hai
**Morning:** face wash → 2–3 drops Vitamin C → moisturizer → **SPF 50 sunscreen**.  
Sunscreen bahut important hai; warna dark spots wapas/darker ho sakte hain. Pigmentation ke results ko generally **6–12 weeks ya longer** lag sakte hain. [www.whowhatwear.com](https://www.whowhatwear.com/beauty/skin/best-products-for-hyperpigmentation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar tum mujhe **apni skin type (oily/dry/combination/sensitive)** aur **budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000)** bata do, main tumhare liye **sirf 1 best serum** choose kar dunga.

sources.snippet:
This article from Who What Wear UK provides a comprehensive guide to the best skincare products for treating hyperpigmentation, featuring insights from dermatologists and skin experts. Hyperpigmentation, a common skin concern caused by excess melanin, can result from sun exposure, hormonal changes (such as pregnancy-related melasma), inflammation, or acne scarring. The guide emphasizes that the cause of pigmentation determines the best treatment and underlines the importance of daily SPF use as the most critical step in both prevention and treatment.

Recommended ingredients include vitamin C, niacinamide, azelaic acid, tranexamic acid, and retinoids, which can be found in both over-the-counter and prescription products. Experts caution that results typically take 6 to 12 weeks, or even months, and consistency in skincare is essential.

The article highlights 13 carefully selected products, spanning cleansers, serums, moisturizers, and SPFs. Notable mentions include La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Cleanser, Eucerin Pigment Control SPF50+, The Ordinary Azelaic Acid 10%, and Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum. Each product is chosen based on expert input, performance, ingredient quality, and user reviews, providing practical options for anyone tackling dark spots and uneven skin tone.
